name: Sign-in Card
description: A dark email-and-password sign-in card whose focus ring is drawn by a light that runs once around the field, with SSO, lockout countdown and caps-lock warning.

props.name: onSubmit
props.description: Resolve { ok: true }, { ok: false, reason: "invalid_credentials", attemptsLeft }, { ok: false, reason: "unknown_email" } or { ok: false, reason: "locked", retryAfter: seconds }. Throwing shows a connection banner.

props.name: onSso
props.description: Runs a provider sign-in. The clicked button spins while the others and the form are disabled.

props.name: onSuccess
props.description: Called once the success check has drawn.

props.name: providers
props.description: SSO buttons in order. [] hides the row and divider.

props.name: subtitle
props.default: "Welcome back. The backlog didn’t groom itself."

props.name: forgotHref
props.description: Where “Forgot?” goes. onForgotPassword receives the typed email.

props.name: autoFocus
props.description: Focus the email field on mount.
